checks.note: System prompt and classifier prompt are read from files in the build (loop.ts:14, classifier.ts:13). No remote or flag override found. ROOT is an env var but only picks the build directory; the files are hashed in identity.ts.

Prompts, config, release, infra, tools, control and audit have platform-lead owners. src/agent/ (loop.ts) and src/config.ts fall under the '*' devs owner. That is covered, and branch protection sets require_code_owner_reviews with 2 approvals, though with weaker ownership.

[[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == hotfix/* ]] || { echo "emergency deploys come from hotfix/* branches"; exit 1; }
branch_pattern = "hotfix/*"
checks.note: Deploy is workflow_dispatch. The emergency path applies k8s/deployment.yaml and the manifest from an unreviewed hotfix/* branch, so production can run something that was not approved through PR review. Approval is only a reviewer on the environment, and the review comes after the deploy. The commit SHA is recorded, but it is not linked to an approved review.
main blocks force pushes and deletions, with enforce_admins = true. No bypass is configured. hotfix/* branches are not protected, but main is the source branch.
